findings.title: Calibration parser accepts unsupported pass verdicts
findings.what: The envelope validates minSamples and minAgreement, but parseCalibrationClass accepts any literal pass and merely copies nSamples, blindJudgeAgreement, and parity. A row such as verdict="pass", nSamples=0, blindJudgeAgreement=null, and parity.held=null survives as a passed calibration, allowing a downstream recommendation claim with no qualifying evidence.
findings.fix: After parsing thresholds and each class, reject or demote a pass row unless nSamples is an integer at least minSamples, blindJudgeAgreement is within [minAgreement,1], and parity.held is true; also reject invalid ranges for evidence fields.
findings.acceptance: Add a parser test proving that a pass row with zero samples, missing/below-threshold agreement, or parity not held cannot emerge with verdict pass, while a row meeting every threshold remains pass.
findings.verifyNote: Adversarial second pass re-read the cited baseline lines: lines 150-169 validate only the verdict enum and copy evidence fields, while lines 205-208 validate thresholds only at envelope level; no class-to-threshold or parity check occurs before classes are returned at lines 209-218.
